entries.title: Narrator: "With the nationalization decisions..."
entries.dialogueText: With the nationalization decisions made, all that was left was for Sordland's two most prominent oligarchs to sign the paperwork. And so I called them both to the Palace conference room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian showed Marcel Koronti and Wa..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian showed Marcel Koronti and Walter Tusk in. They sat across the table from me, leaving one empty chair between them.
